title: Bear Spirit Awakening
description: A surreal split-scene painting featuring a silhouetted braided woman against a sunset on the left, a large glowing bear paw symbol in the fiery sky, and a green aurora with a boat on the right. Below, a black gloved hand reaches toward a cute green dragon-like creature with big eyes wearing a scarf, while a translucent woman's face floats in the center.
prompt: Surreal split composition painting with a silhouetted woman with braids looking at a sunset on the left, vertical sequence of bear paw prints, a giant glowing black bear paw symbol dominating the fiery orange sky, a translucent ethereal woman's face in the clouds, green northern lights and a small boat on dark water to the right, in the foreground a black leather gloved hand reaching out toward a cute green scaly dragon creature with large shiny eyes and a brown scarf, mystical atmosphere blending sunset and aurora
